subunit: Oligomer composed of two heavy chains and two light chains. Interacts with GRIP1 and PPP1R42. Interacts with SYBU. Interacts with JAKMIP1. Interacts with PLEKHM2. Interacts with ECPAS. Interacts with ZFYVE27. Found in a complex with OGT, RHOT1, RHOT2 and TRAK1. Interacts with APP (via cytoplasmic domain)
